description: Role-weighted insider sentiment score on a fixed [-100, +100] scale for a single issuer over a lookback window.  Role weights: CEO/CFO = 3.0 (via officer_title pattern), other NEO Officer = 2.0, 10%-Owner = 1.5, Director = 1.0.  P = +1, S = -1; option exercises, grants, and tax withholdings are neutralised.  Cluster flag = TRUE when ≥3 distinct insiders transacted within any 30-day window inside the lookback. Institutional plan only.

cluster_window_days.description: Sliding window for the cluster_flag detection. Default 30 days.

lookback_days.description: Days back from today to scan transactions for. Default 180.

ticker.description: Issuer ticker symbol — or a CIK (SEC identifier).

name: get_insider_sentiment

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

metrics_display.description: sentiment_score and the buy/sell share and dollar totals rendered for prose ('-87.35', '1.28M shares', '$318.92M'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM instead of the raw numbers.

title: Insider Sentiment (composite)
